thread:
anika: Quick note 1 am starting a lightweight refresh of the 'Hello-Bridge' quickstart. Goals: one-command local run, consistent env var naming, and swap out an old SDK link that 404s. I'll open a draft PR under examples/hello-bridge.

sam: Love it. What does the single-command flow look like for new users?

anika: `cp .env.example .env && npm ci && npm run start` is the idea. I'll include a tiny start wrapper so `npm run start` reads `.env` if present. Example .env.example:```
BRIDGE_API_KEY=your_key_here
BRIDGE_REGION=us-west1
```

oliver: Can we include a migration note for `LEGACY_TOKEN` -> `BRIDGE_API_KEY`? People still hit the old names.

anika: Yep, adding a short Migration section: "If migrating from legacy samples, set BRIDGE_API_KEY to the value of your previous LEGACY_TOKEN secret."

doc-bot: Reminder: docs CI has a linkcheck job. Broken links will fail the PR.

sam: I'll add the linkcheck job to the PR pipeline. Also keep the small Dockerfile stanza for on-prem docs.

anika: Draft PR #5012 created. Checklist: add examples/hello-bridge, .env.example, start wrapper, update README quick run, fix SDK link to https://sdk.redwood.ai/v9/quickstart, add docs CI linkcheck, add a tiny /health smoke test.

oliver: I'll proof text and update screenshots; small alt text note for accessibility.

anika: Pushed fix to start.js (uses dotenv, prefers actual env over .env). CI: linkcheck queued.

doc-bot: linkcheck: external links OK. examples smoke: passing.

sam: LGTM from CI side. Merge when docs approval done.

oliver: Approved and left two tiny copy edits; addressed and pushed.

anika: Merged PR #5012. Will post a short announcement once deployed. Thanks!
